answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, but correlated equivocation links their signed histories: for k coordinated identities, penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), through cross-account slashing. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling entity, rapidly exhausting escrow and making sybil expansion uneconomic. A thread of evidence, its echo across validators, leaves no haven for concealed collusion.
